scoring_justification: Result-level compare against paper-reported values within tolerances; the six scalar surface properties cannot be recomputed from raw DFT output in the checker, so we verify structural agreement with the hidden paper benchmarks.

hidden_assets.purpose: paper-reported values for AgF/NiF (001) surface band gaps, magnetic moments, and electronic specific heat at 300 K
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper abstract and results: AgF gap 0.25 eV, NiF gap 0.19 eV; AgF moment 6.0 μB, NiF moment 8.0 μB; AgF C_V 3.69 J/K·mol, NiF C_V 4.84 J/K·mol
hidden_assets.generation_method: extracted verbatim from the published paper
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact paper‑reported values; no synthesis was needed.

outputs.description: Aggregated results from DFT and BoltzTraP calculations: indirect M–Γ band gaps, total magnetic moments, and electronic specific heat at 300 K for both AgF and NiF terminations. The checker compares these reported values against hidden reference values using pre‑defined tolerances.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker validates that all six fields are present and each value falls within the allowed absolute tolerance of the paper‑reported benchmark. No intermediate raw data is evaluated; only this final aggregate is scored.
